title: Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5
author: Enough-Presence-1117
selftext: What model do you guys think will be better for game dev? Or do you use something else?

comments.author: tomqmasters
comments.body: I'm using opus because fable burned through my budget before I even got to see what the results were.  I'm on the $20/month plan and opus5 on high almost lasts me all week with codex to fill in some gaps for easy stuff.  claude is leagues better than codex these days.

replies.author: ReindeerOk2009
replies.body: Don't touch Fable on a $20 plan, better used on Opus to get more stuff done.

comments.author: -qix
comments.body: Fable is good, but the usage credits put me off using it as it’s inefficient. I use Sol 5.6 to plan and then Opus 5 to actually implement stuff.

comments.author: AnyWriting3715
comments.body: Opus5 is very good at the visual component of games: layout, VFX, etc. Fable 5 is good at thinking through all aspects of the game at once. That is, it’s more like a construction foreman - in theory, he knows how to do everything, but he doesn’t lay the bricks himself. One correction - hasn’t Fable 5.1 been released yet? It seems not.

replies.author: Enough-Presence-1117
replies.body: I know it hasn’t I’m more asking peoples predictions on the model when it drops. I haven’t heard much about it.

replies.author: IAmhowlshot
replies.body:
This has been my exact experience too. Fable has been amazing at planning and forward thinking with many moving parts.   
I make Fable make the plans, and Opus do the work.

comments.author: retro_wrld
comments.body: Opus 5 is goated for anything game related

comments.author: pigletmonster
comments.body:
I started making a game 3d roguelite with opus 4.8, there was a bug that it couldnt fix for 2 or 3 attempts, as soon as opus 5 released  i prompted it to fix that bug and it did it in the first attempt withinin a few minutes.

Also i didnt use it for 3d modelling, i used it to design the map and generate the code. The models were just free assets i foubd online.

It took 1 weej and used 40% of my weekly quota (max 5x plan) to develop the game and release it on itch.io.

replies.author: Enough-Presence-1117
replies.body: Amazing. Go Opus. What’s it called?
